decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. fact: Car 1 forced Car 16 off the track at Turn 1.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code

title: Infringement Car 1 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
